body: Offset opens up about his relationship with Quavo following Takeoff’s tragic passing, revealing that the two NEVER stopped looking out for each other despite fans portraying them as enemies. Offset says he and Quavo even reunited privately in the studio and recorded around 8 or 9 songs while still grieving their brother. “There was no respect for the group. I felt like you wanted us to just continue and say, ‘Leave this man. ’ This man is our legacy. This man is a glue.

source_caption_text:
Offset opens up about his relationship with Quavo following Takeoff’s tragic passing, revealing that the two NEVER stopped looking out for each other despite fans portraying them as enemies. 🕊️💔

Offset says he and Quavo even reunited privately in the studio and recorded around 8 or 9 songs while still grieving their brother. 🎶

“There was no respect for the group. I felt like you wanted us to just continue and say, ‘Leave this man.’ This man is our legacy. This man is a glue.”

For Offset, Takeoff wasn’t just a member of Migos. He was the bond that helped hold the group together. 💔

Would y’all want Offset and Quavo to release those unreleased songs one day? 👀👇
